input.rationale: Section 6.11 is the only audit right binding us (Section 3.8.5/3.8.6 inspection rights run in our favour and are not flagged). It uses an independent nationally recognised accounting firm reasonably acceptable to us and is confined to books and records (no systems access), and Section 6.13 imposes confidentiality on the review, so the qualitative protections are sound. However, the three fallback numeric terms are all left open: the audit frequency period, any prior-notice requirement, and the variance threshold that shifts cost to us are unspecified, so on its face the clause permits repeated, unannounced audits and cost-shifting on any variance. We therefore fix them at the fallback level (once per twelve-month period, fifteen (15) days' prior written notice, cost on Harpoon unless underpayment exceeds 10%). We note but have not redlined Section 6.12, which lets the Audit Expert allocate initial audit costs in a disputed audit.

proposal.summary: Fix audit frequency, notice and cost-shift threshold in Section 6.11 at the fallback position.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The audit right leaves frequency, notice and the cost-shifting threshold unspecified, so we have set them at our fallback: one audit per twelve-month period, fifteen (15) days' prior written notice, and Harpoon bearing the cost unless the audit reveals an underpayment exceeding 10%.
